name: Otokoyu ni Haittekita Onna no Ko o Dou Suru ka 3
original_name: 男湯に入ってきた女の子をどうするか3
source:
Young girls having ecchi fun at a spa designated for men only.
Naughty rock-paper-scissors.
Reciprocal body washing.
Maybe a little stroll without any clothes.
Precocious girls are a gift from heaven. Play with them please!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158796.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
年轻女孩在专为男士设计的水疗中心享受ecchi乐趣。
顽皮的剪刀石头布。
相互清洗身体。
也许可以不穿衣服散步。
早熟的女孩是上天的恩赐。请和他们一起玩吧！
